text:
Dylan Coghlan is back where his NHL career began. The undrafted right shot played 88 games for Vegas early on, bounced through Carolina and Winnipeg, and has now dressed 12 times for the Golden Knights this season at about 14 minutes a night, usually as the third-pair option.

The results are thin. One assist, no goals on 0.56 expected, and with him on the ice at five on five Vegas has taken 45.6% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), 8.8 points worse than when he sits. His ice time has slid from the 15-minute range in October to 11 to 14 minutes in November.

The scouting note that matters comes from Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, in a nine-game sample last season: only 18% of his exits kept possession, so the forecheck is where to watch him. He does own a hard shot (91 mph, 68th percentile by NHL EDGE). For a depth defenseman on a winning team, the question is simply whether he keeps the spot.
headline: Dylan Coghlan is back in Vegas, still chasing a point
